newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST-Polish banks see end-97 CPI at 14.62 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Polish banks see end-97 CPI at 14.62 pct.

text.p: Inflation expectations among Polish banks fell for the second month running in June, a monthly Reuter poll of the 23 biggest banks showed on Tuesday.
Banks predicted average year-on-year inflation for the end of 1997 at 14.62 percent, down from 14.96 percent predicted last month but above the government's goal of 13 percent.
The average June inflation forecast was 0.78 percent.
NOTE: In brackets previous figures for end-97 and May-98 from last month's poll. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 970
